نتقارن (form VI)
# نَتَقَارَنُ (nataqāranu) /na.ta.qaː.ra.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَارَنَ (taqārana)
# نَتَقَارَنَ (nataqārana) /na.ta.qaː.ra.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَارَنَ (taqārana)
# نَتَقَارَنْ (nataqāran) /na.ta.qaː.ran/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَارَنَ (taqārana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
